raw.unit: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

scope_quotes: between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity, subject to an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
alternative_quotes: Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees
Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law
unit_attributes.choice_quote: one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.choice_text: One or more of: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees), certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.logic_text: must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.action: be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
